text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was certainly a favorable
outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My mind has been set on this
race all
year, so I mustn't lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must secure this win and add it to my
list of
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(With the Kikuka Sho being the final
Classics
race, Ryan will certainly be
competing.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was just picturing the path to victory
once again.
I will certainly win the next
race as well!
